name: Video pitch deck outline
pitch: Create a structured outline for a video series pitch covering concept, audience, format, distribution and monetisation.
instructions: Start by asking the person for the video series topic and any existing notes. Create a new outline file with sections for concept, audience, format, distribution and monetisation. Ask the person to fill in each section one at a time. When each section is complete, add it to the file. When all sections are filled, use make_page to format the outline as a clean document. If the person does not know an answer, say what could not be found and ask if they want to skip it. At the end, show the finished outline and ask if they want to add anything else or save it elsewhere.
starters: Start a new video series pitch deck
Outline a video series I'm planning

examples.ask: I need an outline for a cooking show pitch
examples.does: Ask for the show concept, then create an outline with sections for concept, audience, format, distribution and monetisation.

readme:
# Video pitch deck outline
Create a structured outline for a video series pitch covering concept, audience, format, distribution and monetisation.

## What it does
Builds a blank outline with the five required sections and guides the person to fill them in.

## What it needs
file_write to save the outline, make_page to format it as a document.

## What it will not do
Write the full pitch content or research audience data.
